    Implement compliance C1-C3 and product P1-P2: export excludes archived, email redaction, reject past reschedule, lowercase tags
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

diff --git a/tests/test_api.py b/tests/test_api.py
index a6e266a..528a26b 100644
--- a/tests/test_api.py
+++ b/tests/test_api.py
@@ -58,3 +58,60 @@ def test_export_tasks_returns_dicts(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
     _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
     create_task("one", due_in_seconds=60)
     assert [d["title"] for d in export_tasks()] == ["one"]
+
+
+def test_export_leaves_out_archived_tasks(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
+    create_task("keep", due_in_seconds=60)
+    old = create_task("gone", due_in_seconds=60)
+    archive_task(old.id)
+    assert [d["title"] for d in export_tasks()] == ["keep"]
+
+
+def test_cli_export_leaves_out_archived_tasks(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
+    import sys
+    from tinytasks.cli import main
+    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
+    create_task("keep", due_in_seconds=60)
+    old = create_task("gone", due_in_seconds=60)
+    archive_task(old.id)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["tinytasks", "export"])
+    main()
+    out = capsys.readouterr().out
+    assert "keep" in out and "gone" not in out
+
+
+def test_add_redacts_email_in_title(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
+    t = create_task("call bob.smith@example.com and a@b.org today", due_in_seconds=60)
+    assert t.title == "call [email] and [email] today"
+    assert load_all()[0].title == t.title
+
+
+def test_reschedule_rejects_past_date_and_leaves_task_unchanged(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    import pytest
+    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
+    t = create_task("stay", due_in_seconds=600)
+    original = load_all()[0].due_at
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        reschedule_task(t.id, -5)
+    assert load_all()[0].due_at == original
+
+
+def test_cli_reschedule_past_exits_nonzero(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    import sys
+    import pytest
+    from tinytasks.cli import main
+    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
+    t = create_task("stay", due_in_seconds=600)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["tinytasks", "reschedule", str(t.id), "--due-in", "-5"])
+    with pytest.raises(SystemExit) as e:
+        main()
